title: Antifragility
hook: One bad month shouldn't be able to sink your whole business.
statement: Some businesses get stronger from chaos instead of weaker. You can build yours to be one of them.
explainer: A restaurant can die from one slow month. A lab where most experiments fail can still win big off the rare hit. The difference is structure: small downside, big upside, some slack.
sop: List where a shock would hurt you most.
Add options there, like a second supplier or a backup channel.
Favor bets where you can lose a little but win a lot.
Keep cash and slack instead of squeezing out every buffer.
Score Convex Payoffs, Optionality, and Recovery Capacity from 1 to 10.
equation_example: Convex Payoffs 6, Optionality 7, Recovery Capacity 5. (6 + 7 + 5) ÷ 3 = 6.0. Higher means rough patches make you stronger. Lower means every shock just piles on more damage.
question: Name one spot where a surprise would hurt you, and one change that could make it help.
closing_statement: Don't just survive the chaos. Build so it helps you.
caption:
Principle Nº 325: Antifragility

One bad month shouldn't be able to sink your whole business.

Some businesses get stronger from chaos instead of weaker. You can build yours to be one of them.
